items.title: Principal Database Engineer
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken’s Core Infrastructure Engineering team builds and operates the shared data systems behind critical production services. Our estate spans on-premises and cloud infrastructure, with MariaDB at its centre and Kafka, Redis and Elasticsearch across the wider platform. We’re hiring a Principal Database Engineer to bring long-term experience and technical judgment to this estate. You’ll assess it, set the goals and direction, and work hands-on with the team to deliver measurable improvements. This is an individual contributor role with influence across teams and several quarters of work. THE OPPORTUNITY - Review the estate against business needs and production evidence. Judge reliability, scale, cost and operational complexity, identifying what should be preserved and where investment or simplification would make a difference. - Define the target architecture and measurable goals. Agree a prioritised roadmap with engineering leads and dependent teams, explaining the trade-offs and sequencing work around delivery risks. - Execute that roadmap with the team through design, implementation and adoption. Stay personally involved in difficult migrations and scaling decisions, with representative benchmarks, data-integrity checks and credible cutover and rollback plans. Adapt the plan as evidence changes and verify the results in production before calling the work complete. - Investigate difficult MariaDB failures and performance limits through the engine, storage and application behaviour. Improve fleet reliability through useful observability, safer changes and tested backup, restore and disaster recovery procedures. Set recovery objectives with service owners and prove them through exercises. - Build and maintain production software for database provisioning, upgrades and routine maintenance. Make self-service workflows safe and auditable, incorporating access controls and change evidence with Security and Compliance. - Work with application teams on schemas, transaction boundaries, queries and data-store choices. Make the operational consequences clear and resolve dependencies that span teams. - Mentor engineers across the team through design reviews, pairing and incident analysis. Help them deepen their database expertise and take ownership of technical decisions. - Participate in on-call and incident response, leaving clear operational ownership and following through on lessons from production. WHAT YOU BRING - 8+ years operating and evolving production database estates at scale. You have assessed inherited systems, set technical direction and delivered improvements with engineering teams, and can explain how those decisions held up over time. - Strong understanding of high availability, replication and distributed database failure modes. You can explain consistency and availability trade-offs and reason about transaction boundaries and reliable event delivery, including transactional outbox patterns. - Deep, recent hands-on MariaDB expertise, including InnoDB, MVCC and transaction isolation, locking, query optimisation, binary logs and MariaDB GTID replication. You can explain the mechanisms and diagnostic evidence behind your decisions. - Personal ownership of MariaDB incident diagnosis, performance tuning and tested restore or point-in-time recovery. You can explain what you did, how you established data integrity and what remained uncertain. - Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, Rust or a comparable language. You have personally built and maintained production software or automation for database workflows such as provisioning, failover, online schema changes and self-service operations, using version control, code review and delivery pipelines, with tested failure handling. - Strong low-level Linux, Kernel, storage and networking fundamentals, with the ability to investigate problems beyond the database process. - Clear written technical judgment and demonstrated delivery across teams without reporting-line authority. You help stakeholders make sound database design and lifecycle decisions, and develop experienced engineers through shared delivery. NICE TO HAVES - Experience operating databases in containerised, hybrid on-premises/cloud or multi-region environments. Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code or GitOps, including their operational trade-offs. - Experience with database proxies or load-balancing layers (MaxScale, HAProxy, ProxySQL, or similar). - Experience with PostgreSQL, Vitess, TiDB, ScyllaDB, ClickHouse or internal database platforms; operational knowledge of Kafka, Redis/Valkey or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. - Experience in regulated environments or contributions to database engines, operators and other infrastructure software. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. items.title: Partner Applied AI Engineer, Oracle and Cloud ISV
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Applied AI Engineering team helps developers and enterprises deploy generative AI safely and effectively. We serve as trusted technical advisors, helping customers and partners move from early experimentation to production-scale AI systems. As a Partner Applied AI Engineer focused on Cloud ISVs, you will work with Oracle Cloud, Snowflake, and Databricks to help customers adopt OpenAI. You will bring OpenAI capabilities to the applications, data platforms, and developer workflows customers already use, then turn successful deployments into approaches the field and partner teams can deliver independently. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an experienced technical leader to work with partner architects, AI specialists, and sales teams across three distinct routes to market. You will lead technical work from joint account discovery and architecture through evaluation and production, alongside OpenAI account teams and partner sellers. You will help customers choose the right deployment and purchasing path for the workload, with clear ownership of security, billing, support, and operations. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: Strategic partner engagement and influence - Build relationships with Oracle, Snowflake, and Databricks field leaders and technical teams. Shape joint account plans, identify the customer problem each partner can help solve, and prioritize opportunities with a clear path to production and reuse. - Oracle Cloud: Work with Oracle sellers on eligible, sales-managed Oracle Marketplace private offers for OpenAI API models, ChatGPT Work, and Codex. Distinguish procurement, billing, and eligible commitment drawdown from OpenAI-managed product access, inference, and support. Where customers build on OCI, design the application and data integration without assuming the model is hosted on OCI. - Snowflake: Work with Snowflake account and technical teams to qualify data and AI workloads where OpenAI models in Snowflake Cortex AI are a fit. Help customers evaluate use cases such as AI functions over governed data, search, analytics, and agents. Confirm model and regional availability, data boundaries, and operating requirements. Distinguish Snowflake-metered Cortex usage from a customer application that calls OpenAI directly. - Databricks: Work with Databricks sellers and solution architects on three joint plays: developer workflows with Codex and Unity AI Gateway, enterprise insights with ChatGPT and Genie where supported, and GPT-powered applications and agents with Mosaic AI Model Serving, Agent Bricks, and Databricks Apps. Validate each route against the customer’s governance and deployment requirements. Distinguish Databricks-billed usage from direct OpenAI billing and confirm commercial eligibility and attribution before making commitments. Complex deal leadership and execution - Lead technical discovery, architecture, prototyping, evaluation, and production readiness. Agree with both account teams on what the customer will deploy, how success will be verified, and who owns the next step. - Validate model and feature availability, identity and network boundaries, data handling and residency, capacity, metering, and support ownership. Work with Alliances, Sales, and Billing Ops on technical readiness without taking ownership of pricing, terms, offer acceptance, or billing approvals. Solution architecture and hands-on building - Build reference implementations with OpenAI APIs and partner-native capabilities, such as OCI application and data services, Snowflake Cortex AI, and Databricks Mosaic AI Model Serving. Use the appropriate integration path for the workload and validate permissions and data movement before deployment. - Put evaluation, observability, and deployment practices in place to measure quality, safety, reliability, latency, cost, and real workload usage. Ecosystem enablement and scale - Create demos, workshops, reference architectures, and playbooks that partner engineers, field teams, and systems integrators can use independently. Pair on early deployments, then hand off proven patterns with clear prerequisites and support paths. Cross-functional leadership and feedback - Work with Alliances, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Enablement to resolve blockers. Turn patterns across accounts into specific product feedback backed by evidence, and keep field guidance current on what is supported, what is limited, and what is not yet available. YOU'LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have substantial experience leading technical engagements with enterprise engineering and business leaders across pre- and post-sales. - Have hands-on depth in at least one of OCI, Snowflake, or Databricks and can build credible architectures across the others. You understand enterprise data governance and know how to integrate OpenAI products into production systems. - Can build in Python or a comparable language and have practical experience with APIs, retrieval, tool use, LLM evaluation, and secure cloud deployments. - Can explain how a workload is purchased, accessed, served, metered, and supported without conflating those decisions. You build trust across sales and engineering, and measure success through customer adoption and partner self-sufficiency. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. You will shape joint technical strategy, define engagement models, and build systems that scale beyond individual deals. Working across pre- and post-sales, you will guide enterprise customers from discovery through production while enabling Google Cloud and its partners to lead subsequent deployments. This role combines hands-on engineering, technical judgment, and ecosystem leadership. You will bring deep familiarity with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI), particularly Model Garden and its Python SDK tooling, and help customers choose supported OpenAI integration paths based on workload requirements, model capabilities, security controls, and operational needs. items.title: Senior AML Investigator
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket US operates under CFTC oversight as a regulated prediction market, which means the compliance function carries real regulatory weight. The AML team is responsible for detecting and reporting suspicious activity across a user base that transacts through card, ACH and stablecoin rails, and the work requires both financial crime expertise and the ability to think clearly about a product that looks different from a traditional bank or broker. The team is small and the caseload is real. This hire matters because investigation quality is the core of what we do. You will own your casework, from initial review through SAR filing or documented declination, and your judgment will directly shape how the program holds up to regulatory scrutiny. You will also be a resource for the analysts around you, which means your standards become their standards. The environment moves fast. Polymarket is growing, the regulatory landscape for prediction markets is still developing, and the compliance program is being built to match that pace. If you want a role where the work is clearly defined and the edge cases are rare, this is not it. If you want to do serious investigative work at a company where compliance has a seat at the table, it is. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Investigate escalated cases from transaction monitoring, fraud referrals, market surveillance and sanctions screening for signs of money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud and sanctions evasion. - Analyze funding, withdrawal and trading patterns across card, ACH and stablecoin rails, including linked account activity, to build a clear picture of what a customer is doing and why. - Prepare detailed Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) that meet regulatory requirements and internal policy, and document decisions when no SAR is needed. - Review customer identity and profile information to assess whether activity fits the customer's known background and stated purpose. - Support law enforcement requests, subpoenas and 314(a) reviews. - Perform quality control reviews of analyst work and provide direct, actionable feedback as needed. - Help analysts work through complex cases, and develop job aids and training materials that raise the baseline quality of the team's output. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 4 or more years of hands-on AML investigation experience, including writing SARs that have been filed with FinCEN. - Strong working knowledge of the Bank Secrecy Act, SAR filing requirements and core AML regulations. - Demonstrated ability to analyze transaction activity across multiple payment rails and draw well-supported conclusions about the nature of that activity. - Clear written communication, specifically the ability to write SAR narratives that are accurate, organized and defensible. - Experience with investigative research tools such as CLEAR or LexisNexis, and with case management systems. - A track record of managing a caseload independently, meeting deadlines and maintaining quality under volume. - (Plus) Experience with blockchain analytics tools (such as Chainalysis, TRM or Elliptic) and on-chain tracing. - (Plus) Experience at an exchange, FCM, broker-dealer, prediction market, or sports betting or gaming operator. - (Plus) Familiarity with CFTC or NFA rules, or with derivatives and event contracts. - (Plus) Experience applying AI tools to investigation workflows, or a clear interest in doing so. - (Plus) CAMS certification or equivalent. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

items.title: Sanctions Compliance Officer
items.description: SANCTIONS COMPLIANCE OFFICER ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket US is hiring a Sanctions Compliance Officer to build and lead our sanctions compliance program and the operational screening function that supports it. This is a hands-on role within the Financial Crimes organization with responsibility for both program strategy and day-to-day operations across our growing U.S. business. We are looking for someone who is both a deep sanctions subject matter expert and a strong operator. You should bring extensive knowledge of U.S. economic sanctions requirements, including OFAC regulations and guidance, as well as demonstrated experience building and running effective sanctions operations. You will own the policies, controls, screening framework, escalation standards, technology, and governance that support the sanctions program, while also building and leading a standalone sanctions team responsible for reviewing sanctions alerts. This is not a purely advisory or policy role. The Sanctions Compliance Officer will be responsible for ensuring the program works effectively in practice, including establishing operational procedures, staffing and managing the screening team, setting productivity and quality standards, overseeing escalations, and continuously improving screening effectiveness. The role will work closely with Legal, Compliance, KYC, AML, Product, Engineering, and Operations. You should be equally comfortable interpreting sanctions requirements for a new product or counterparty, designing a screening control, managing an operational queue, and diving into a complex sanctions escalation. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own and continuously enhance Polymarket US's sanctions compliance framework, including policies, procedures, governance, risk assessments, screening controls, escalation standards, and supporting documentation. Serve as the company's primary sanctions subject matter expert, translating OFAC requirements, U.S. economic sanctions programs, regulatory developments, and emerging risks into practical controls and operational requirements. Own the end-to-end sanctions screening framework across customers, transactions, counterparties, beneficial owners, and related parties, including requirements for list management, matching logic, thresholds, testing, quality assurance, and ongoing effectiveness reviews. Build and lead the sanctions team responsible for executing the screening framework, including establishing staffing, workflows, procedures, escalation criteria, service levels, quality standards, and performance expectations. Manage the investigation and disposition of sanctions screening alerts, including potential sanctions matches, ensuring decisions are consistent, well documented, and aligned with applicable requirements. Develop and maintain escalation and decision frameworks for potential blocked or prohibited activity, partnering with Legal and senior Compliance leadership on significant matters and regulatory reporting where required. Advise Legal, Compliance, Product, and business teams on sanctions risks associated with customers, counterparties, products, jurisdictions, transactions, and new business initiatives, including ownership and control considerations and application of OFAC's 50 Percent Rule. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to embed sanctions controls into onboarding, transaction flows, and other relevant product processes and to continuously improve screening effectiveness. Establish a strong quality and testing framework to assess whether sanctions controls are operating as designed and to identify opportunities to improve accuracy, consistency, and efficiency. Identify and implement opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve the effectiveness, consistency, and efficiency of sanctions screening and alert reviews, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, controls, testing, and governance. Ensure the sanctions function remains closely integrated with KYC, AML Investigations, Fraud, and other Financial Crimes teams. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 8+ years of sanctions, financial crimes, AML, or related compliance experience, with significant direct responsibility for U.S. economic sanctions. Deep subject matter expertise in OFAC regulations, sanctions programs, and guidance. Demonstrated experience building or leading both a sanctions program and sanctions / financial crime screening operations within a regulated financial institution, FinTech, broker-dealer, derivatives firm, payments company, or similarly complex environment. A combination of sanctions advisory and operational leadership experience - this role requires someone who can interpret complex requirements and build and manage the teams and processes used to execute them. Experience leveraging AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve sanctions screening, alert review, investigations, or other financial crimes processes, with a practical understanding of appropriate governance, testing, and human oversight. Hands-on experience with sanctions screening, alert investigation, escalation, disposition, and blocked or rejected transaction analysis. Experience designing or overseeing sanctions screening systems, including matching logic, tuning, testing, list management, QA/QC, and false-positive reduction. Experience establishing operational metrics, productivity expectations, quality programs, escalation frameworks, and queue-management processes. Experience advising on sanctions risks associated with customers, counterparties, jurisdictions, transactions, products, and new business initiatives. Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance and operational controls. Experience drafting sanctions policies, procedures, risk assessments, escalation standards, and operational documentation. Experience supporting regulatory exams, audits, investigations, or independent testing. Strong judgment and the ability to independently assess and escalate complex sanctions matters. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate sanctions risks and recommendations to senior leadership and non-specialist stakeholders. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment and build a program and operations function while the business continues to scale. Plus Prior experience working at the U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC).. Experience at a CFTC- or NFA-registered entity, including a DCM, DCO, or FCM. Experience with digital assets, blockchain analytics, or sanctions risks associated with crypto or blockchain-based activity. Experience implementing or enhancing sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening technology. Experience building a screening operations function from the ground up. BENEFITS Competitive salary & equity Unlimited PTO Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage 401k match Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

As Senior Certification Specialist, you’ll be the team’s subject-matter expert: leading complex certification and audit projects, owning our day-to-day relationships with accredited test labs and setting how the team certifies across markets, so launches stay on track and the Group’s licences stay protected. You’ll work closely with the Gaming, Casino, Change Management and Technical Compliance teams, as well as external test labs and game suppliers, and report to the Certification Manager. It’s a role with real ownership and variety: you’ll shape procedures, turn regulatory and technical-standard changes into practical requirements, and help build the capability of the wider team by mentoring Certification Specialists and Officers. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Lead end-to-end certification and audit projects for games, platform and critical components across our regulated markets - Own day-to-day relationships with accredited test labs, including scoping, quotes, timelines and escalations - Act as the senior escalation point for complex certification issues raised by the business and the certification team - Monitor regulatory and technical-standard changes and turn them into clear certification requirements - Review certificates and test reports for gaps and agree corrective actions with labs and game suppliers - Plan certification timelines with stakeholders so certification never blocks a launch - Own and improve internal certification procedures, market checklists and post-certification reviews - Mentor Certification Specialists and Officers and share jurisdiction knowledge across the team OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - In-depth knowledge of certification requirements for online gambling across multiple regulated markets - Extensive experience working with accredited test labs, including scoping, quotes and resolving findings - Solid understanding of online gambling games and platforms, including game, platform and critical-component certification - Proven ability to run many certifications in parallel against fixed launch dates - Experience monitoring regulatory change and assessing its impact on certification NICE TO HAVES - Experience mentoring or coaching others - Confident user of Jira, Confluence or similar tracking tools WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments. JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!
